{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZiUbPQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDJIDM", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 113, "title": "Add an evidence-qualified Wakaba beginner OLT journey with separate room context", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `35b59cedec19db31d79c4c309f0a33daf72c0f73`, MAIN/index → `16` opens Wakaba’s welcome, but only selector `1` for its beginner board is available. Users cannot inspect Wakaba OLT attendance, enter a beginner conversation, speak or leave through Wakaba.

This omits a documented service distinction: Wakaba supported synchronous OLT participation separately from retained-message operations. It is an existing fidelity gap, not a demonstrated regression introduced by PR #112.

## Expected outcome

Provide this browser-local journey:

`MAIN or index → 16 → 2 OLT → WHO 1 → JOIN 1 → quiet reading or speech → /LEAVE → OLT directory → BACK → Wakaba welcome → BACK → actual caller`

Add one separate fictional beginner room named `はじめての談話室`, with stable internal ID `wakaba` and directory selector `1`. Welcome selector `2`, the room name/ID, directory, controls and presentation are **category D reconstruction**, not recovered historical identifiers.

Reuse the existing OLT implementation, shared fictional residents, identity rendering, consent, presence, inference ownership and bounded persistence. Preserve the existing DAISIZEN route and its two rooms. Wakaba must not alias either room or expose their attendance/transcripts through contextual selector mistakes.

## Context

### Historical evidence and accepted tolerance

Sources inspected live on 2026-10-24:

- The [まいとーく client-author description](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/net/se024554.html) explicitly lists Wakaba among locations supporting OLT attendance inspection and participation, separately from retained-message operations. Confidence is high in the stated capability; release dating and applicability throughout 1996 remain unresolved. This does not authenticate host commands or layout.
- The [participant reference](https://www2s.biglobe.ne.jp/nozomin/kanri/pcvan.html) identifies Wakaba as a corner for communication beginners and distinguishes OLT from board chat. This is retrospective firsthand documentation with undated practices: moderate historical confidence for purpose, without a target-year directory or control sequence. Its closure chronology is not independently established.
- The [March 1993 NEC PC-VAN office article](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jkg/43/3/43_KJ00002959297/_pdf/-char/ja), printed page 232, describes simultaneous multiparty OLT. Its earlier service account supports the experiential distinction, not Wakaba’s late-1996 configuration. Extracted text has damaged spacing.
- The [MAIN reproduction](https://paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm) labels its later example circa 1996 and places Wakaba at selector 16. Confidence is high in the displayed reproduction, while historical applicability remains provisional. Its December 1999 credit does not date every revision, and it provides no Wakaba secondary screen.

Focused Japanese/English searches covered Wakaba OLT, 1995/1996, manuals, commands and rooms. They recovered no qualifying target-year secondary menu or session. The linked [client package-metadata page](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/dl/win95/net/se024554.html) remained inaccessible; accessible participant and NEC documentation supplied alternatives. Encyclopedia mirrors surfaced unsupported room-count, tariff and cultural claims; none establishes requirements here.

**Accepted tolerance:** moderate confidence in a separate beginner synchronous experience; low confidence in its exact 1996 configuration. Reuse the existing reconstructed JOIN/WHO and slash controls. Use concise original Japanese guidance and a beginner-oriented room culture that welcomes questions and allows silence. Do not invent historical shortcuts, tariffs, opening/closure dates, graduation requirements or universal conflict stereotypes. Do not seed archived conversation, introduce historical identities, manufacture attendance or guarantee replies.

### Implementation evidence

- `src/navigation.ts` renders Wakaba with only board selector `1`; `isOlt` recognizes only the DAISIZEN service route. Carry an explicit OLT context through navigation, `ConnectionController`, application wiring and `TerminalOlt`, rather than relying on the boolean to select a global directory.
- `src/olt.ts` hardcodes the DAISIZEN heading, enumerates every room and parses JOIN/WHO with `[12]`. Resolve local selectors against the current context for rendering, attendance, entry and in-room moves.
- `src/olt-state.ts` defines `lounge` and `night`; `validateOlt` requires exactly two rooms. `oltState` validates before returning a clone. Merely changing the count to three would reject valid existing stored worlds and backups.
- `src/storage/schema.ts` validates the reserved OLT setting and member references before import. `LocalRepository.changeOlt` validates transactional mutations; import validates before replacing records atomically. Preserve these boundaries through an explicit compatibility path.
- `observeOlt` assigns residents across rooms under existing routines and probabilities. Preserve one-room-per-resident constraints and legitimate absence. `buildOltPrompt` already uses bounded recent room lines and public memory, excluding private mail; add beginner culture through this existing path.
- OLT has a persistent **24-attempt hourly budget shared across all rooms**, separate from the forum/mail generation quota. It also uses shared inference locking. Reuse both; adding or entering Wakaba must not create another allowance or reset existing attempts.

[Issue #53](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/53) established the existing OLT journey and safeguards. [Issue #109](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/109) explicitly excluded Wakaba OLT. Current repository-scoped open-Issue/open-PR searches returned no items; Wakaba/OLT history recovered #109 without an equivalent handoff. Lexical duplicate detection is incomplete and inventory can change.

[PR #112](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/112) and `docs/validation.md` report 63 focused and 407 complete-suite passing checks with three workers, configured type checking/build and diff review. These are Coordinator records, not checks performed by this research graph. Default/eight-worker reliability remains unresolved.

Scope is one Wakaba OLT room and the compatibility/integration necessary to use it safely. The complete historical directory, authenticated host controls, broader MAIN expansion and real generated-language assessment remain separate work.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add welcome selector `2 OLT` without changing selector `1` or its forum destination. The Wakaba OLT directory exposes only its one room and accurate local attendance. Support WHO/JOIN, HELP/LIST and useful invalid-input guidance. `/LEAVE` and `/BACK` return from the room to that directory; directory BACK returns to Wakaba; the next BACK restores the actual MAIN/index caller. `/MAIN` returns directly to MAIN. Retain the existing DAISIZEN two-room journey and labels.
- [ ] Resolve every room selector against the active context. In Wakaba, directory `2`, `JOIN 2`, `WHO 2` and `/JOIN 2` must not select or reveal an existing room. Conversely, existing selectors must not enter Wakaba. Keep transcripts, sequence counters, replay cursors and pending turns associated with stable room IDs. Leaving, moving or invalidating the active context must cancel its inference and prevent late output from reaching another visit.
- [ ] Reuse established terminal ownership: plain text is speech inside a room, slash commands operate the room, and `//` escapes a leading slash. Preserve anonymous reading without a fabricated identity, HANDLE guidance/registration, Settings transitions, shared identity tokens/safe names, date rendering, bounded replay, literal Japanese output, input/focus preservation, IME guards, logging and pacing/skip behavior.
- [ ] Implement a bounded compatibility path for worlds with no OLT setting, valid legacy version-1 states containing exactly `lounge` and `night`, and the new complete three-room state. Validate legacy records before normalization. Add only an empty Wakaba room; preserve existing transcript content, IDs, counters, timestamps, budget window/attempts and valid reservations, subject to normal lifecycle expiry/cancellation. Do not reset OLT or reseed community records. Normalization must be idempotent across repeated reads, reloads, concurrent tabs and JSON restore. Reject malformed legacy states, duplicate/unknown rooms, invalid references and malformed new states before destructive writes; retain rollback on import/write failure. Document the chosen representation without an unrelated database or backup-format redesign.
- [ ] Reuse existing fictional resident identities, routines, consent, presence leases and scheduling. Permit quiet/empty visits; never add scripted historical chat or forced replies. Preserve at-most-one-room resident presence across all three rooms and same-human multi-tab attendance semantics. All rooms share the existing 24-attempt hourly OLT cap, duplicate-commit arbitration, timeout and shared inference lock. Consent withdrawal, activity zero, hidden tabs, departure, restore/reset and stale connections must retain their cancellation/commit safeguards.
- [ ] Add beginner-oriented context to the existing OLT prompt while preserving short conversational output, the late-1996 setting, present-speaker restrictions and bounded public memory. Include neither private mail nor another OLT room’s transcript. Mocked output for an absent/incorrect speaker, wrong room, invalid text or duplicate utterance must fail without appending. Prompt assertions establish context construction, not real-model cultural quality.
- [ ] Extend existing Playwright controller, production-terminal and IndexedDB coverage. Cover both entry parents; anonymous and registered quiet/speaking visits; attendance, command ownership, invalid cross-context selectors, departure/re-entry and existing-room regression; legacy two-room upgrade, missing setting, new-state round-trip, repeated/concurrent normalization, malformed imports and rollback; cross-tab attendance/turn arbitration, shared cap, delayed mocked replies and cancellation. Use fixed clocks and existing mocked inference helpers; no real model, GPU or external service is required.
- [ ] In deterministic inactive fixtures, compare protected records before/after visits and compatibility handling. Permit only intended OLT-setting changes and normal session/history bookkeeping, plus explicitly requested handle changes. Preserve existing Wakaba/SIG posts and counters, mail/read confirmations, conference/NetNews records, read markers, unrelated settings, resident preferences and consent. Keep existing functional, storage, consent, IME and terminal assertions meaningful.
- [ ] Update README, affected navigation/storage documentation, research records and discoverable Settings/About with the actual subset, source/access dates, confidence, compatibility behavior and category D choices. Keep routine screens concise. The Coordinator runs focused coverage using `npm test -- tests/olt.spec.ts tests/olt-repository.spec.ts tests/wakaba.spec.ts tests/wakaba-repository.spec.ts tests/navigation.spec.ts tests/connection.spec.ts tests/storage-controls.spec.ts --workers=3`, including any additional new spec, then `npm test -- --workers=3`. Configured servers already perform TypeScript checking and production build. Record actual failures, corrections, skips and worker settings; inspect the complete diff, affected links and `git diff --check`. Three-worker success must not be described as resolving default-worker reliability.

## Optional validation

Compare against a subsequently recovered dated Wakaba manual/session. Former-user feedback or native Japanese IME checks may refine presentation but are not completion gates. Real generated-language assessment remains separate; no model download or inference is required for this Issue.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. All acceptance checks are achievable before merge against local production assets.
